name: Priya S.
text: Our kids (7 and 10) loved the mastani stop. Raj adjusted the spice for them at every counter.

name: Daniel K.
text: The best way to understand Pune. Small group, great stories, far more food than I expected.

name: Neha & Arjun
text: Loved it. Evenings get busy in the lanes, so go for the 4:30 slot if you can.

name: Kiran M.
text: Short, punchy and full of drama. My parents loved it.

name: Sara L.
text: Great intro to Pune’s history before the food walk.

name: Aditi R.
text: Saved our rainy afternoon! Kavya is so patient with kids.

name: Tom & Mia
text: Our wonky bowls arrived home safely. Lovely studio.

name: Rhea P.
text: Short and sweet, literally. Grandma loved the stories.

name: Ishaan
text: Solid rainy-day plan. The mastani station is the highlight.

name: Vaishali
text: Short, calm and full of stories. Perfect filler before dinner.

name: Meghna
text: Goosebumps. My son still drums on every table.

name: Luca
text: Nothing else like it. So welcoming.

name: Fatima
text: Came home with a copper pot and zero regrets.

name: Ananya
text: Meditative and beautiful. The artist’s stories were the best part.

name: Gauri
text: Felt like being invited into someone’s home.

name: Zoya
text: Cosy and delicious. Loved the mawa cake stop.

name: Rahul
text: Didn’t expect so much green inside the city.

name: Omkar
text: Classic Pune sunset spot.

name: Helen
text: Moving and very well told.

name: Kabir
text: Great lineup, loud and fun.

name: Sneha
text: Our 5-year-old refused to leave!

name: Revathi
text: Mesmerising craft. Free and generous.
